hero.description: Help us create joyful, inclusive cultural experiences while introducing your organisation to families and communities across North Kent.

tiersSection.intro: Choose a package or speak with us about shaping a bespoke partnership around your preferences.

tiers.name: Coupon Sponsor
tiers.description: Your branding will feature on approximately 1,500 complimentary lunch and dinner coupons distributed to visitors across the four-day celebration.
benefits: Visible branding on complimentary lunch and dinner coupons

tiers.name: Banner Sponsor
tiers.description: Build consistent visibility for your organisation throughout the celebration.

tiers.name: Title Sponsor
tiers.description: Take the leading sponsorship position for Kashphool's 2026 Durga Pujo.
benefits: Potential category exclusivity, subject to agreement

tiers.name: Event Stalls
tiers.description: Meet visitors in person and bring your food, products, services or organisation into the heart of the four-day celebration.
benefits: A dedicated venue space to showcase your brand, promote your services or sell your products.

bespoke.heading: Bespoke partnership possibilities
bespoke.intro: Depending on the agreed partnership level, we can combine selected opportunities into a package that supports your objectives.
possibilities: Prominent branding across the venue over all four days
Inclusion in our digital and social-media promotion
A dedicated promotional or information presence at the event
Distribution of QR codes, offers, subscriptions or service-related promotional material
Branding on complimentary lunch and dinner coupons distributed to visitors

sponsors.heading: Sponsors
sponsors.intro: We are grateful to the organisations whose support helps us bring our community celebrations to life.
